summary: This Form 6-K filing by Americas Gold and Silver Corporation reports its Q1 2026 financial and operational results, highlighting record silver production and sales driven by improvements at the Galena Complex and commercial production at EC120. It also notes a joint venture with United States Antimony to build an antimony processing facility. The filing is a routine earnings release, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change is disclosed.
